## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`) if behavior changed
- [ ] Changeset added (`npx changeset`) for user-facing changes
- [ ] No env value or source text can reach output, logs, errors or generated files (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
